slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover background video for the hero, rendered by the <BoomerangVideoBg> component. Plays through ONCE (not natively looped), capturing every frame to offscreen canvases via requestVideoFrameCallback (60fps setInterval fallback), each frame scaled to max-width 960px; on 'ended' it hides the <video>, reveals a <canvas>, and replays the captured frames at 30fps in an infinite forward-then-reverse boomerang. Wrapper is absolute inset-0 w-full h-full and the host container is fixed inset-0 z-0 pushed 200px down (style top:200) so the clip sits behind the lower hero. Supply a seamless-looking clip whose start/end read well boomeranged; crossOrigin='anonymous' so the source must be CORS-enabled for the canvas capture to work.

Navbar wordmark/logo on the left of the
lockup (). Height-constrained to 24-28px, width auto; sits over the light #F7F7F7 page so a dark or full-color transparent PNG/SVG reads best. Currently the local /image.png placeholder ('user's own logo PNG').

Single UI typeface applied globally (font-family:'Inter',sans-serif on body). Drives the StaggeredFade headline (up to lg:text-6xl, font-normal #31463B), nav links, badge pill, subheading body, and CTA labels. Weights 300-900 are imported (300;400;500;600;700;800;900). Native family 'Inter', loaded from Google Fonts in index.css.

Four inline UI glyphs from lucide-react, tinted by CSS (currentColor / fill classes), not baked into the asset: Globe (w-4 h-4, language selector), Leaf (w-4 h-4, inside primary CTA), Play (w-3/4, fill-white text-white in primary CTA's gradient circle), ArrowRight (w-3/4, fill-black text-black in secondary CTA's gradient circle). Replace with brand glyphs supplied as currentColor-driven icons so the white/black fill tinting still applies.

mechanic: Light-canvas SaaS hero over a fullscreen frame-captured boomerang background video (plays once, then ping-pongs its frames forward/reverse at 30fps on a canvas) while the headline reveals one character at a time via a useInView staggered opacity fade and the subheading and CTAs fade-down on scroll-in.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite component spec using Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion (motion + useInView), and lucide-react; a clsx + tailwind-merge cn() helper; custom utilities (.liquid-glass, .tracking-tight-custom, @keyframes scroll) plus the Inter @import declared in index.css; canvas/requestVideoFrameCallback drive the boomerang background.
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in JSX (headline 'Renewable Power For Tomorrow, Infinite Clean Solutions', subheading sentence, badge 'Delivering power innovate' with mobile-shortened 'Power innovate', 5 nav links, 'Sign In', 'Clean Energy', 'Explore Options', 'Start Network', 'En', logo alt 'LGPSM') and must be edited in markup. The renewable-energy / emoji badge narrative (sun, globe, plant emojis) is baked into the markup and reads as solar-specific, so a non-energy reskin needs different glyphs and badge wording. Several greens and gradients are hardcoded inline rather than via CSS vars: heading #31463B (inline style), primary CTA gradient #3C684D->#4A7144 (Tailwind arbitrary values), primary CTA icon-circle linear-gradient(59deg,#567A5E,#78A873) and secondary icon-circle linear-gradient(59deg,#EEEEEE,#CBCBCB) (inline style), so reskinning means editing JSX/Tailwind classes, not just a token block. Body/nav use Tailwind gray-600/gray-700 utilities (no literal hex) and borders use black/20, so muted/border colors live in utility classes. The 200px downward offset on the video container and Inter's metrics (tracking-tighter, leading-tight, letter-spacing -0.06em) are layout-tuned. The boomerang background requires a CORS-enabled (crossOrigin anonymous) video source or the canvas frame-capture silently fails.
